python3 << 'EOF'
import numpy as np

# Yields data
yields = np.array([3.25, 3.22, 3.19, 3.06, 3.04, 2.96, 2.9, 2.85, 2.73, 2.7, 2.72, 2.7, 2.62, 2.6, 2.64, 2.65, 2.68, 2.68, 2.77, 2.92, 2.92, 2.92, 2.91, 2.91, 2.96, 3.02, 3.0, 2.96, 2.96, 2.97, 2.94, 2.93, 2.98, 3.1, 3.03, 2.98])

# Time index (t = 1, 2, ..., 36)
t = np.arange(1, len(yields) + 1)

# OLS: Y = a + b*X
# Using normal equations: b = Cov(X,Y)/Var(X), a = mean(Y) - b*mean(X)

n = len(yields)
mean_t = np.mean(t)
mean_y = np.mean(yields)

# Calculate slope (b) and intercept (a)
cov_t_y = np.sum((t - mean_t) * (yields - mean_y)) / n
var_t = np.sum((t - mean_t)**2) / n

b = cov_t_y / var_t
a = mean_y - b * mean_t

print(f"Number of observations: {n}")
print(f"Mean of t: {mean_t}")
print(f"Mean of yields: {mean_y}")
print(f"Cov(t, y): {cov_t_y}")
print(f"Var(t): {var_t}")
print(f"\nOLS Regression: Y = {a:.6f} + {b:.6f} * t")

# Predicted values
y_pred = a + b * t
residuals = yields - y_pred
ss_res = np.sum(residuals**2)
ss_tot = np.sum((yields - mean_y)**2)
r_squared = 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot)

print(f"\nR-squared: {r_squared:.6f}")
print(f"Standard error of estimate: {np.sqrt(ss_res/(n-2)):.6f}")

# Forecast for July 1956 (t = 37)
t_forecast = 37
y_forecast = a + b * t_forecast

print(f"\nForecast for July 1956 (t={t_forecast}):")
print(f"Y = {a:.6f} + {b:.6f} * {t_forecast} = {y_forecast:.6f}")
print(f"Rounded to three decimal places: {y_forecast:.3f}")

a = (sum_y - b * sum_t) / n

print(f"Sum of t: {sum_t}")
print(f"Sum of y: {sum_y}")
print(f"Sum of t^2: {sum_t2}")
print(f"Sum of t*y: {sum_ty}")
print(f"\nSlope (b): {b}")
print(f"Intercept (a): {a}")

# Calculate R-squared
y_pred = [a + b * ti for ti in t]
mean_y = sum_y / n
ss_res = sum((yields[i] - y_pred[i])**2 for i in range(n))
ss_tot = sum((yi - mean_y)**2 for yi in yields)
r_squared = 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot)

print(f"\nR-squared: {r_squared}")

# Forecast for July 1956 (t = 37)
t_forecast = 37
y_forecast = a + b * t_forecast

print(f"\n=== FORECAST FOR JULY 1956 ===")
print(f"t = {t_forecast}")
print(f"Y = {a} + {b} * {t_forecast}")
print(f"Y = {y_forecast}")
print(f"\nRounded to three decimal places: {round(y_forecast, 3)}")
EOF
